turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We have about two kilos of leftover roast turkey. I'm so sick of sandwiches.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. How about a turkey curry, a pie, or fried rice? All of them hide the leftover feeling well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fried rice sounds fun. Do I need day old rice for that?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ideally yes, it fries better because it's drier. Fresh rice works if you spread it on a tray to cool first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We have rice from Tuesday. Is that still okay?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's pushing it. Cooked rice is best eaten within a day, so I'd make fresh.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. What else goes in it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Egg, spring onions, peas, soy sauce and a little sesame oil. Shred the turkey and add it near the end so it warms through.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And can I freeze the rest of the turkey

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: or is it too late now?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If it's been in the fridge less than three days, freeze it today in portions. It'll keep for a couple of months.
